# REMAINING_WORK

Status: EMPTY

The dynamic-character work graph is closed for the requested scope. Neutral identity remains separate from regional expression. Speech and visemes, gaze, blink, body acting, phased gestures, hands, garments, secondary motion, views, persistence, preview, production rendering, and export have implementation and verification evidence.

No known safe in-scope implementation, regression, persistence, render, scale, or export node remains open. New product requests belong to a new work graph rather than this completed checkpoint.
